description: This test file contains test cases for functions parsing CLI JSON outputs related to AI model sessions, specifically for Claude and Gemini models. It tests parsing of JSON strings and objects representing session metadata, responses, usage stats, and stream events in different formats.

methods.name: parseCliJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string or object representing CLI output, extracting response text, session ID, and usage metrics for models like Claude and Gemini.

methods.name: parseCliJsonl
methods.description: Parses newline-delimited JSON objects from a stream, extracting response text, session ID, and usage metrics, supporting streaming output scenarios.
